  "pros": [
    "User-friendly interface that is easy to navigate for the team.",
    "Efficiently manages customer support activities through web channels.",
    "Seamless integration with other Zoho applications for a unified ecosystem."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Occasional slowness in the software can hinder productivity.",
    "Limited customization options, particularly with customer cards and modules.",
    "Live chat saving features need improvement for better traceability."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Customer Service Manager found Zoho Desk to be a highly user-friendly and efficient tool for managing web-based customer service, appreciating its straightforward interface and integration capabilities. While generally satisfied, they noted frustrations with occasional performance slowdowns and a lack of flexibility in certain customization areas. Despite minor drawbacks, the product adequately supported their team's customer support operations."
